name: Unified Super-System Tracker
goal: Single integrated setup path across Sandbox, WSL2, Hyper-V, Docker, Dev Drive, AIHub, Hermes/XCore, security hardening, and autoboot operations.

phases.title: Easy Wins Before Merge
phases.objective: Capture immediate low-risk setup wins while larger integration code continues.
phases.upgrade_path: Promote successful checks into startup automation + recurring validation task.

phases.title: Task Board + Evidence Sync
phases.objective: Keep active task dashboards, summaries, and source citations synchronized with engineering changes.
phases.upgrade_path: Automate weekly refresh and diff against previous artifact snapshots.

phases.title: Disk + Dev Drive Foundation
phases.objective: Move dev/data workloads off C and establish deterministic folder topology.
phases.upgrade_path: Enable ReFS Dev Drive policies + scheduled drift checks.

phases.title: Runtime Substrate (WSL2/Hyper-V/Sandbox/Docker)
phases.objective: Deploy isolation-capable substrate for dev + AI workloads with rollback-friendly layout.
phases.upgrade_path: Add automated VM and WSL image checkpoint rotation.

phases.title: Core Toolchain + SDK Bulk Setup
phases.objective: Install VSCode, GitHub/Azure tooling, Python/.NET/Node, and secure build stack.
commands: winget install Microsoft.VisualStudioCode Git.Git GitHub.cli Microsoft.AzureCLI Microsoft.DotNet.SDK.8 Python.Python.3.12 NodeJS.NodeJS
phases.upgrade_path: Pre-cache SDKs on Dev Drive to reduce reinstall time.

phases.title: AIHub + SQL + Vector + Fleet Mesh
phases.objective: Create shared AIHub knowledge plane used by Hermes/XCore fleets and subagents.
phases.upgrade_path: Enable fleet-wide SQL feature snapshots and vector replay validation.

phases.title: Meta-Learning + Deep Engines
phases.objective: Activate 30-engine deep learning fabric + 10 parallelization families with C++ optimization grounding.
phases.upgrade_path: Promote adaptive policy from recommendation to live autonomous scheduler.

phases.title: Security, Watches, Quarantine, Governance
phases.objective: Use C++ source-of-truth controls for internet watch, ports, quarantine, folder permissions, and compression governance.
phases.upgrade_path: Attach live watchdog automation to fleet rollback + isolation hooks.

phases.title: GUI Unification + Operator Flow
phases.objective: Run one clean GUI for setup, metrics, deep engines, security watches, and training controls.
phases.upgrade_path: Add role-based views for operator, researcher, and security analyst personas.

phases.title: Autoboot, Self-Heal, and Upgrade Stubs
phases.objective: Lay stubs for single-exe orchestration, startup checks, rollback, and rapid integration of future modules.
phases.upgrade_path: Compile signed bootstrap launcher with health-gated module sequencing.

stubs_for_later: Single EXE launcher wrapping PowerShell + C# control host.
Automated BIOS/hardware profile inference with safe mode constraints.
Secure online model fetch + signature verification flow.
Adaptive installer retries with mirror fallback and quarantine isolation.
